problem_statement:
Jetpack Onboarding: Introduce a success screen for Contact Form step
If the users have inserted a form and connected successfully, we will display this screen instead of the contact form tile. If they haven't inserted a contact form, they should see the tile, and if they haven't connected, we should lead them to the JPC flow if they try to reach step 4 again.

It's worth to mention that this is the point where we should move the actual contact form insertion to, because it should happen only after the user has connected.

![](https://cldup.com/06u0fqzCrV.png)

For more information see p6TEKc-1Rd-p2
FAIL_TO_PASS: ["getJetpackOnboardingPendingSteps() - should return pending status for the contact form step"]
PASS_TO_PASS: ["getJetpackOnboardingPendingSteps() - should return pending status for the stats step", "getJetpackOnboardingPendingSteps() - should return pending status for the woocommerce step"]
